game.title: Noah Farm
hint.desktop: Click a plot or the stall · Hold and drag or WASD to walk · Wheel: zoom · 1–9: switch tool
hint.touch: Hold and drag a finger to walk · Tap a plot or the stall to use · Pinch to zoom
webgl.error: This browser does not support WebGL, so the game cannot run.
notice.noSeeds: Out of seeds, buy more at the stall
shop.title: Market stall
shop.nothingToSell: Nothing to sell yet. Harvest something and come back!
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Tap two slots to swap them. The first row is your toolbar.
menu.title: Menu
save.codeHint: Paste this code on another device to move your farm there.
save.newGameConfirm: Press again to confirm (your current farm is kept as a backup)
save.remind: It's been over 7 days since your last backup. Open the Menu to download one.
save.remindShort: Back up now: it's been over 7 days.
save.iosTip: On iPhone, tap Share → Add to Home Screen so Safari doesn't erase your data after 7 days away.
save.quota: Browser storage is full. Download a backup file from the Menu.
save.failed: Couldn't save your progress. Download a backup file from the Menu.
save.welcomeBack: Welcome back! You were away for {time}
save.ripeWhileAway: {n} plots ripened while you were away
save.error.corrupt: File is damaged or not Noah Farm data
save.error.tooNew: Data is from a newer game version
recovery.title: Couldn't read your save
recovery.body: The save data in this browser has a problem: {reason}. The damaged copy is kept, not deleted.
loading.failed: Couldn't load game assets. Check your connection and reload.
animal.needHay: You need hay to feed it, buy some at the stall
animal.content: {name} is full and happy, about {minutes} min until {item}
fish.waiting: 🎣 Wait for the bobber to dip…
fish.reelHint: Drag the green zone onto the fish, or hold the screen to lift it
fish.caughtNew: 🎉 New species: {item}! Added to your fish log (+{xp} XP)
fish.tooFar: Get closer to the pond to cast
land.bought: 🌱 Field expanded! You now have {n} plots
land.locked: 🔒 Not yours yet; buy it at the stall for {price} gold
ride.tamed: 🐮 {name} is tamed! Stand close and press R (or 🐮) to ride
ride.notNear: Stand next to a tamed cow to ride
ride.noTamedCow: No tamed cow yet. Feed and pet a cow every day until it is 100 happy
shop.furnitureHint: Purchases go to your bag; inside the house, press 🛋️ to place them.
house.notSleepy: Not sleepy yet, you can sleep after 6 PM
house.bought: 🛋️ Bought {item}, press 🛋️ inside the house to place it
decor.title: Decorate
decor.empty: No furniture in your bag. Buy some at the stall, Furniture tab.
decor.placeHint: Tap the floor to place {item} · ⟳ to rotate
decor.pickHint: Pick an item to place, or tap placed furniture to store it
quest.q_coop: Build a coop at the stall (Farm tab)
quest.tutorialDone: 🎉 Tutorial complete! New tasks every day from now on
quest.allDaily: 🎉 All of today's tasks done! +{xp} XP
journal.title: Journal
journal.bonusHint: Finish all 3 for an extra {xp} XP. New tasks every day.
journal.bonusClaimed: All done for today. See you tomorrow!
npc.mia.line1: The bread smelled amazing this morning, come by!
npc.mia.line2: Fresh veggies make the best pastries.
npc.mia.ask: I need {what} for my baking, can you help?
npc.tom.line1: The fish are biting today, give it a try.
npc.tom.line2: Fishing takes patience, just like farming.
npc.tom.ask: I could really go for {what}, got any?
npc.lan.line1: Your farm has the prettiest flowers!
npc.lan.line2: I am learning flower arranging, so fun.
npc.lan.ask: Do you have {what}? I need it for a party.
npc.bao.line1: Fresh ingredients are the secret to good food!
npc.bao.line2: I am trying a new recipe today.
npc.bao.ask: I need {what} for this week’s menu.
npc.rosa.line1: The market is lively this week.
npc.rosa.line2: My basket always needs more veggies.
npc.kai.line2: Fresh wood smells like rain on soil.
npc.kai.ask: All this work made me hungry, could you bring {what}?
order.boardHint: Villagers post orders here. Deliver in time for gold and XP.
order.none: No orders right now. Check back tomorrow!
order.firstNote: Your grandpa grew the best veggies in town! Could you grow me {what}?
pwa.updated: ✨ A new version was downloaded and will be used next time
social.title: Friends
social.visitHint: Send this link so friends can stroll around {name}'s farm (view only). It's a snapshot from now; make a new one to show changes.
social.shareText: Come visit {name}'s farm in Noah Farm!
social.inviteHint: New players who start from this link get 500 gold.
social.copyFailed: Couldn't copy, please select and copy it manually
menu.name: Farmer name
visit.broken: That visit link is broken, opened your own farm
visit.readOnly: You're visiting, look but don't touch
invite.gift: 🎁 Welcome gift from a friend: +{gold} gold!
menu.powerHint: Caps the game at 30 FPS, turns off shadows and thins out grass and flowers; cooler phone, longer battery.
look.title: Character
look.classicHint: You're the original straw-hat farmer. Pick “Custom” or “Random” to make your own character.
fish.reelHintMouse: Hold the mouse and move it up or down to keep the green zone on the fish
weather.today.rain: 🌧️ Rainy day: crops get watered and fish bite faster
weather.today.storm: ⛈️ Stormy day: crops get watered and rare fish bite more often
weather.today.snow: 🌨️ Snow is falling on the farm
